audit.primary_source_citation: NO PRIMARY SOURCE TESTS THIS CLAIM. The row is anchored on the nearest-to-primary study with the correct experimental architecture: Liu VV, Sandor K, Yan PK, Miao Z, Yin Y, Stickels RR, Chen AY, Hiam-Galvez K, Gutierrez J, Zhang W, Sajjath SM, Valbuena R, Wang S, Daniel B, Ludwig LS, Howitt BE, Lareau CA, Satpathy AT. "Clonal lineage tracing of innate immune cells in human cancer." Cancer Cell 2026 Jul 13;44(7):1509-1521.e4. PMID 42242233; doi 10.1016/j.ccell.2026.05.006; author manuscript NIHMS2184724 / PMC13309241 (not yet released); bioRxiv preprint doi 10.1101/2025.07.16.665245, PMID 40777278 (CC-BY, full text read); GEO GSE302113 (verified to exist, titled "Clonal lineage tracing of innate immune cells in human cancer"). HINT VERIFICATION: every element of the hint about this paper checks out (PMID, Cancer Cell 2026, GSE302113, mtscATAC in NSCLC tumour + non-involved lung + blood, myeloid-focused conclusions) EXCEPT the claim that NK were treated "only as part of an aggregate innate category" — see audit_overturns_detail. Largest marker-based source that has ever been offered in support: Nat Immunol 2024 pan-cancer tumour-infiltrating NK reference-mapping atlas, PMID 38956379 / PMC11291284 (427 tumour patients, 136 healthy-tissue donors, 2,176,214 transcriptomes) — which explicitly declines to make the inference.
audit.fulltext_unavailable_reason: Published Cancer Cell full text is paywalled (cell.com/cancer-cell/fulltext/S1535-6108(26)00251-5 returned HTTP 403) and the NIHMS author manuscript PMC13309241 is deposited but not yet released in PMC (lit.py methods PMC13309241 -> STATUS=NOT_FOUND). The complete CC-BY bioRxiv preprint (doi 10.1101/2025.07.16.665245, 84 KB incl. full Methods) WAS retrieved and read and is archived at /home/user/aaa/refs/X1_dataset_biorxiv_PPR1052262.txt. The preprint and the published paper report the identical cohort and cell count (218,715 cells, 23 samples, 5 NSCLC + 5 ovarian patients), so the methods read are the methods published; I could not verify that no NK-specific analysis was ADDED in revision. All quotes below are from the preprint Methods/Results, not from any abstract.
audit.species: Human (Homo sapiens) for the anchor study. Counter-evidence and adjacent literature audited additionally in mouse (C57BL/6; Ducimetière PNAS 2021, Torcellan Immunity 2024, Horowitz Sci Transl Med 2026) and rhesus macaque (Wu Front Immunol 2022 barcoding).
audit.what_was_measured: In humans, in freshly dissociated surgical material sampled ONCE at the time of resection (single timepoint; no timecourse, no pre-tumour sample — the organ was never observed before the tumour arose), mtscATAC-seq (joint single-cell ATAC + mitochondrial-DNA heteroplasmy) was run on matched tumour, non-involved lung tissue (NILT, non-adjacent, tumour-free on pathology) and PBMC. Readouts measured were: (a) assignment of cells to mtDNA-variant-defined clones by the Mitotrek framework; (b) cell identity from chromatin-accessibility gene scores at NCR1, GNLY, KLRD1, CD3D, CD8A; (c) per-clone cell-type composition; (d) the fraction of clone-sharing cell pairs for each cell-type pair, within a tissue site and across tissue sites. Measured in 10 patients (5 early-stage NSCLC post-lobectomy with tumour+NILT+blood; 5 ovarian cancer with tumour, 3 with matched blood), 23 samples, 218,715 cells. CRITICAL NEGATIVE: no NK-specific tumour-versus-NILT clone-sharing test was performed; no pre-tumour timepoint, no fate mapping, no photoconversion, no parabiosis, no intravascular labelling, no exogenous barcode exists anywhere in this or any other study for this transition.
audit.n_unit: patients (donors): 5 NSCLC patients with matched tumour + non-involved lung + blood, 5 ovarian cancer patients with tumour (3 with matched blood). 23 samples; 218,715 cells. Cells are NOT the unit of replication. The single NK-informative tumour is n=1 patient (ovarian SU-O-005) and the single NK-informative NSCLC cross-site observation is n=1 patient (SU-L-005). Effective n for anything bearing on this claim = 0.
audit.controls: Within the anchor study: (1) Mitotrek benchmarked against published full-length scRNA-seq of single-colony-derived HSPCs with ground-truth clonal identity, 2 independent donors, 91.3% and 85.3% clone-assignment accuracy at a deliberate sensitivity cost (39.9%/55.1% assignment vs ~80% in the original study); (2) randomised cell-grouping null showing same-clone cells share a cell type more than chance; (3) matched PBMC as the circulating comparator and NILT as the tumour-free same-organ comparator; (4) explicit artefact controls for solid-tissue mtDNA lineage tracing — variants detected in >20% of cells within a sample discarded, cells assigned to multiple clones excluded, correlated variants collapsed — introduced because the authors found high-heteroplasmy variants shared across lineages in solid tissue but not PBMC, attributed to ambient mtDNA uptake and/or horizontal mitochondrial transfer; (5) clone-assignment rate shown to be uniform across cell types and tissue sites (15–26% tissue, 20–32% PBMC), so NK are not differentially dropped. MISSING CONTROL, and it is the decisive one: there is no pre-tumour or tumour-free-timepoint sample of the same organ in the same patient, so "resident before the tumour" is not measurable by this design even in principle. No parabiosis / no CD45.1-CD45.2 chimera / no Hobit or Ncr1-CreERT2 fate map / no Kaede photoconversion of uninvolved organ / no adoptive transfer — none of these are possible in human surgical material.
audit.strongest_alternative_explanation: De novo acquisition of residency markers by newly recruited circulating NK — i.e. the intratumoural "trNK" was never in the organ before the tumour. Circulating cNK recruited into a tissue acquire a bona fide residency phenotype in situ: Torcellan et al., Immunity 2024 (PMID 38157853, PMC10783803) showed viral and bacterial skin infection recruits cNK that differentiate into Tcf1-hi CD69-hi trNK transcriptionally resembling human tissue CD56bright TCF1-hi NK, Blimp1-dependent. TGF-beta in the TME is sufficient to drive CD49a+CD103+ trNK differentiation from peripheral NK ex vivo (Horowitz et al., Sci Transl Med 2026, PMID 42090477), and chronic activation alone drives a tissue-resident-LIKE state via KLF2 loss (Blood 2025, PMID 40857665). Under this alternative, CD49a/CD103/CD69/ITGA1/ITGAE on intratumoural NK is a TME-imposed phenotype, not a residency pedigree, and marker identity to organ trNK carries zero lineage information. TWO FURTHER ALTERNATIVES, both with support: (i) TWO INDEPENDENT ORIGINS with no conversion — Ducimetière et al., PNAS 2021 (PMID 34183415) found in mouse liver metastasis that pre-existing liver trILC1 and recruited cNK are non-redundant and functionally partitioned (trILC1 controls metastatic seeding, cNK restrains outgrowth), i.e. the resident and the tumour-active populations are different cells doing different jobs, not one becoming the other; (ii) IN-SITU DIFFERENTIATION FROM IMMATURE PRECURSORS — tumour-infiltrating immature ILCs in colorectal cancer are biased toward ILC1/trNK differentiation (Nat Commun 2026, s41467-026-71085-9), a third origin that also produces trNK-marked intratumoural cells without any pre-existing mature organ trNK. The canonical "pre-existing subset is selected/expanded rather than converted" alternative is therefore not merely unexcluded — it is the better-supported reading, and the recruitment alternative is better supported still.
audit.counter_evidence: FOUND, and it is substantial. (1) Liu 2026 itself, the anchor: NK cells are DEPLETED in NSCLC tumour relative to NILT ("including enrichment of B and plasma cells and depletion of NK cells in the tumor relative to NILT"); the cell-type-pair clone-sharing analysis puts NK in the group whose pattern "suggest[s] that they originated from recent hematopoietic output without substantial clonal bottlenecks prior to tissue infiltration" — i.e. recent marrow output, the opposite of long-lived pre-tumour organ residency; and the ONLY NK-specific cross-site clonal result in the organ-matched cohort runs blood->tissue, not organ->tumour: "Among 14 peripheral blood-enriched clones, 10 were dominated by CD8+ T cells and 2 by NK cells from a single donor (SU-L-005)... the majority of cells from these clones were detected in PBMCs (66.0%), smaller fractions were present in tumor (25.3%) and NILT (8.8%)". (2) The single tumour with real NK infiltration was OVARIAN (SU-O-005), for which NO matched non-involved ovary was collected — only tumour and blood — so the trNK-before-tumour comparison was structurally impossible there; and its expanded NK clones were "absent from matched peripheral blood, indicating a tumor-restricted NK response", which is equally compatible with local expansion of recruited cells. (3) Nat Immunol 2024 pan-cancer NK atlas (PMID 38956379): "Compositional differences between normal and tumor tissues suggests some degree of active recruitment, particularly in SKCM where NK cell frequencies starkly increased, albeit expansion from tissue-resident pools cannot be excluded" — the largest existing dataset explicitly refuses the inference. (4) Torcellan Immunity 2024 (PMID 38157853): recruited circulating NK become trNK de novo. (5) Ducimetière PNAS 2021 (PMID 34183415): resident trILC1 and recruited cNK are separate non-redundant populations in liver metastasis. (6) Blood 2025 (PMID 40857665): residency-like phenotype arises from chronic activation via KLF2 deficiency. (7) The field states the test cannot currently be done: "the current lack of experimental tools to block recruitment of circulating NK cells or to specifically target the newly identified resident cells currently precludes testing this possibility."
audit.downstream_dependency: CONCRETE NAMED DEPENDENCY: Horowitz NB, Mohammad IA, Shin JH, ... Sunwoo JB, "CD39+CD49a+CD103+ cytotoxic tissue-resident natural killer cells infiltrate and control solid epithelial tumor growth in mice," Sci Transl Med 2026;18(848):eadw5567 (PMID 42090477). That paper's entire translational proposition — differentiate and expand CD39+CD49a+CD103+ ctrNK ex vivo as an adoptive-cell-therapy platform for solid tumours — rests on the premise that the CD49a+CD103+ NK phenotype found inside tumours is the functionally superior, tissue-adapted state worth reconstructing. Note the irony that cuts against X1: Horowitz make their ctrNK BY TGF-beta-differentiating PERIPHERAL NK ex vivo, which is a demonstration that the phenotype does not require prior organ residency at all. SECOND NAMED DEPENDENCY: within this registry, rows T1 (cNK -> trNK) and T4 (NK -> ILC1 within tumours) are mutually constraining with X1 — if intratumoural CD49a+ "trNK" are recruited cNK converting in situ, X1 is false and the phenomenon is fully absorbed by T1/T4, so X1 cannot be graded independently of them. THIRD: the prognostic literature reading CD49a+ NK accumulation as a pre-existing organ-resident compartment, concretely "Accumulation of Tumor-Infiltrating CD49a+ NK Cells Correlates with Poor Prognosis for Human Hepatocellular Carcinoma," Cancer Immunol Res 2019 (PMID 31311791), whose causal interpretation changes entirely depending on whether those cells were in the liver before the tumour.
audit.audit_overturns_detail: Claude's initial call, "NEVER TRACED," is CONFIRMED and if anything understated. Across 19 distinct searches I found no study in any species that has traced organ-resident trNK present before a tumour into the intratumoural NK compartment — no mtDNA lineage tracing, no mtscATAC, no exogenous barcoding, no mouse fate mapping (Hobit/Ncr1-CreERT2), no parabiosis, no Kaede photoconversion of uninvolved organ, no transplant-genotype study. The claim has never been tested, and no paper I found asserts it on lineage data; where it is asserted at all it is asserted on residency-marker overlap. WHAT THE AUDIT DOES OVERTURN IS THE HINT, not Claude's call. The hint stated that Liu 2026 "reported myeloid findings and treated NK only as part of an aggregate innate category." That is only half right. Liu did fold NK into an aggregate innate group for the headline cell-type clone-sharing statement ("innate immune cells, including monocytes, macrophages, DCs, and NK cells, consistently exhibited high levels of clone sharing"), but the paper ALSO contains two NK-SPECIFIC analyses the hint does not anticipate: (a) an NK-identity-verified (CD3D-/CD8A-/NCR1+/GNLY+ chromatin) oligoclonal NK expansion in ovarian tumour SU-O-005 whose expanded clones were absent from matched blood, and (b) two blood-enriched NK clones in NSCLC donor SU-L-005 distributed 66.0% PBMC / 25.3% tumour / 8.8% NILT. Neither tests X1: (a) is in the one malignancy with no matched non-involved organ tissue, and (b) runs blood->tissue. The precise finding is therefore sharper than "NK were aggregated": Liu 2026 is the only human dataset ever assembled with the sampling architecture (matched tumour + tumour-free same organ + blood) AND the endogenous clonal marker (somatic mtDNA) needed to test X1, it had NK cells in hand in both compartments, and it did not run the tumour-versus-NILT NK clone-sharing comparison. The test is one analysis away from being answerable on already-public data (GSE302113), and it has not been done. That, not an absence of tools, is the state of the field for the lung; note the residual obstacle that Liu found NK depleted in tumour vs NILT, so the analysis may be underpowered at n=5.
audit.methods_quote: Liu et al. 2026, preprint Results, verbatim: "Consistent with previous reports of adaptive-like, oligoclonal NK cell responses in human cytomegalovirus infection, we observed expanded NK cell clones in NILT and peripheral blood. While NK cells were rarely detected in most tumors, one ovarian tumor (SU-O-005) exhibited substantial NK infiltration. These NK cells lacked chromatin accessibility at CD3D and CD8A loci but showed accessibility at NCR1 and GNLY, confirming their NK identity. Clonal analysis revealed an oligoclonal architecture resembling adaptive lymphocytes. Notably, expanded NK clones were absent from matched peripheral blood, indicating a tumor-restricted NK response." AND, on the aggregate innate statement: "innate immune cells, including monocytes, macrophages, DCs, and NK cells, consistently exhibited high levels of clone sharing, suggesting that they originated from recent hematopoietic output without substantial clonal bottlenecks prior to tissue infiltration." AND, on the only NSCLC NK cross-site result: "Among 14 peripheral blood-enriched clones, 10 were dominated by CD8+ T cells and 2 by NK cells from a single donor (SU-L-005). Although the majority of cells from these clones were detected in PBMCs (66.0%), smaller fractions were present in tumor (25.3%) and NILT (8.8%), indicating their ability to infiltrate tissue." AND, cohort, verbatim Methods/Results: "we applied mtscATAC-seq to profile five patients with early-stage non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) who had undergone therapeutic lobectomy... For each patient, we collected tumor resections, non-adjacent NILT (not involved by tumor on pathological analysis), and peripheral blood samples." Nat Immunol 2024 pan-cancer NK atlas (PMID 38956379), verbatim: "Compositional differences between normal and tumor tissues suggests some degree of active recruitment, particularly in SKCM where NK cell frequencies starkly increased, albeit expansion from tissue-resident pools cannot be excluded."

audit.notes:
VERDICT: X1 is UNTESTED, not merely weakly supported. There is no primary source; the strongest thing ever offered for it is residency-marker overlap (INF_MARKER) between intratumoural NK and organ trNK, and the largest atlas that could make that argument explicitly declines to.

HINT VERIFICATION, item by item. (a) PMID 42242233, Liu VV et al., Cancer Cell 2026 — EXISTS, verified, 44(7):1509-1521.e4, doi 10.1016/j.ccell.2026.05.006. (b) GSE302113 — EXISTS, verified via NCBI GEO, title matches the paper. (c) "did mtscATAC clonal tracing in NSCLC tumour + non-involved lung + blood" — CORRECT: 5 NSCLC patients post-lobectomy, tumour + non-adjacent NILT + PBMC. (d) "reported myeloid findings" — CORRECT, the paper's conclusions are entirely myeloid (monocyte -> macrophage/DC3 clonal linkage, DC-biased vs macrophage-biased clones, peripheral pre-programming). (e) "treated NK only as part of an aggregate innate category" — PARTLY WRONG; see audit_overturns_detail. Two NK-specific analyses exist, neither testing X1.

WHY THE ANCHOR STUDY CANNOT SUPPORT X1 EVEN IN PRINCIPLE, beyond the missing analysis: mtDNA clonal tracing at a single post-tumour timepoint identifies clonal relatedness, not temporal order. A clone containing both a NILT NK and a tumour NK is equally consistent with organ->tumour, tumour->organ, and blood->both. Establishing "resident in the organ BEFORE the tumour" requires either a pre-tumour timepoint (impossible in human resection material) or a residency-locking manipulation (parabiosis, photoconversion, intravascular labelling — all mouse-only). This is why the honest classification is INF_MARKER and why no upgrade is available from the existing human data.

THE TRM ANALOGUE (requested by the hint) DOES NOT RESCUE THE CLAIM — it is the cautionary case. In the far better-studied T-cell field, where somatic TCR rearrangement gives a true clonal barcode that NK entirely lack, the analogous question is still not cleanly answered: TCR-overlap analyses find TRM and exhausted TIL show LIMITED clonal overlap with each other, sharing instead mostly with TEM, and Kaede photoconversion of mouse tumours (Torcellan PNAS 2017, PMC5465915; JEM 2022 TCF-1 trafficking study) shows intratumoural lymphocytes are continuously recruited AND continuously egress to the draining node rather than forming a stable resident pool. So the field with the better tool has not established the structurally identical claim, which makes an NK version of it — asserted with no clonal marker at all — considerably weaker than it is usually presented.

CLOSEST TRUE CLONAL DATA ON TISSUE NK ANYWHERE: Wu C et al., Front Immunol 2022, PMID 36605190 / PMC9808525, HSPC barcode clonal tracking in rhesus macaque, which found tissue NK have a clonal distribution pattern distinct from blood NK. Correct tool, correct cell type, WRONG SETTING — no tumour. This is the design that would answer X1 if run in a tumour-bearing animal.

CHEAPEST PATH TO ACTUALLY TESTING X1: re-analyse GSE302113 for NK-specific tumour-vs-NILT clone sharing in the 5 NSCLC donors, benchmarked against the CD8 T-cell and myeloid sharing rates the authors already computed. Caveat: NK are depleted in tumour relative to NILT in this cohort and clone-assignment rate is 15-26% in tissue, so the analysis is likely underpowered at n=5 and a null result would not be informative. A properly powered version needs either a tumour type with abundant intratumoural NK plus matched uninvolved organ (Liu's ovarian SU-O-005 had the NK but not the organ tissue), or a mouse autochthonous model with photoconversion or parabiosis performed BEFORE tumour induction.

ARCHIVED FULL TEXTS (all under /home/user/aaa/refs/, tagged X1): X1_dataset_biorxiv_PPR1052262.txt (Liu 2026 preprint, complete), X1_42242233.txt (Liu 2026 PubMed record + refs), X1_42090477.txt (Horowitz STM 2026), X1_PMC8271692.txt (Ducimetiere PNAS 2021), X1_PMC10783803.txt (Torcellan Immunity 2024, OA full text), X1_PMC9808525.txt (Wu macaque barcoding, OA full text).

G-RULE COMPLIANCE: G1 — what_was_measured is stated as species/condition/timepoint/readout/n and never as "showed that A becomes B"; all quotes are from Methods/Results of retrieved full text, never an abstract. G2 — no pseudotime or RNA-velocity result was counted as observation; the CRC ILC-differentiation-bias result is logged as INF_TRAJECTORY. G3 — four searches returned literally zero hits and are recorded as such; NOT FOUND is reported as NOT FOUND, and the one unretrievable item (published Cancer Cell full text, HTTP 403) is declared rather than paraphrased from its abstract. G5 — n is 10 patients, cells explicitly flagged as not the replication unit. G7 — the presence of an OBS_GENETIC-capable technique (mtDNA clonal tracing) in the anchor study was deliberately NOT used to upgrade the claim's class, because that technique was never applied to this transition; evidence_types_all lists only classes actually offered in support of X1. G8 — Claude's "NEVER TRACED" was treated as a hypothesis and actively attacked with 19 searches across four tracing modalities and the TRM analogue field; it survived.

adv.challenge_reason:
The prior row's INF_MARKER call rests on a factual error, and the error is stated as an absolute: "no pre-tumour timepoint, no fate mapping, no photoconversion, no parabiosis, no intravascular labelling, no exogenous barcode exists anywhere in this or any other study for this transition." A congenic parabiosis experiment in tumour-bearing animals, with a pre-tumour organ enumeration in the same paper, has existed since 2016 and the auditor never found it: Dadi S, Chhangawala S, Whitlock BM, Franklin RA, Luo CT, Oh SA, Toure A, Pritykin Y, Huse M, Leslie CS, Li MO. "Cancer Immunosurveillance by Tissue-Resident Innate Lymphoid Cells and Innate-like T Cells." Cell 2016;164(3):365-377. PMID 26806130, PMC4733424, doi 10.1016/j.cell.2016.01.002. lit.py methods returns ABSTRACT_ONLY (author manuscript, not in the OA subset; Europe PMC fullTextXML returns 0 bytes), so I read the PMC HTML directly by curl and by WebFetch and quote it verbatim below; archived at /home/user/aaa/refs/X1_PMC4733424.txt (abstract) with the verbatim passages reproduced here.

WHAT WAS ACTUALLY MEASURED (G1). In C57BL/6 mice in vivo, in the autochthonous MMTV-PyMT mammary model (plus TRAMP prostate), four separate readouts: (a) flow-cytometric enumeration of GzmB+ CD49a-hi NK1.1+ cells split by TCR-negative (ILC1-like, "ILC1l"), TCRbeta+ and TCRdelta+ (ILTC1) in mammary glands of 8-week-old wild-type versus PyMT mice — verbatim: "Notably, GzmB-expressing cells from all three lineages were present in WT mice at low numbers (Figure 1D-F). Cell transformation expanded all populations, with TCRalphabeta and TCRgammadelta lineage cells proportionally more represented in PyMT mice"; (b) CD45.1/CD45.2 congenic PARABIOSIS, pairs surgically joined at 6 weeks of age and analysed 2 weeks later (i.e. at 8 weeks, at the precancerous/early-lesion stage), readout = per-population percentage non-host chimerism — verbatim Results: "parabiosis experiments revealed that the degree of non-host chimerism was much lower for ILC1ls, TCRalphabeta+ ILTC1s and TCRgammadelta+ ILTC1s when compared to cNK, TCRalphabeta+CD8alpha+NK1.1- and TCRgammadelta+NK1.1- cells, respectively (Figure 5B-C). These findings demonstrate that ILC1ls and ILTC1s are tissue-resident lymphocytes"; (c) EdU incorporation in CD49a-hi GzmB+ cells from pooled mammary glands of 8-week-old WT and PyMT mice (local proliferation); (d) genetic requirement tests — Nfil3-/- (cNK "greatly reduced", ILC1l unperturbed), Il15-/- and Prf1-/- tumour-growth curves.

WHY THIS IS A CLASS UPGRADE, NOT A SUPPORT UPGRADE. Congenic parabiosis is the recruitment-versus-residency instrument the prompt itself names, and here it is applied to the intratumoural/peri-lesional CD49a+CD103+ NK1.1+ population in a tumour-bearing animal, with the same organ enumerated before transformation. That is not marker overlap; it is an in vivo congenic labelling experiment, i.e. OBS_TRANSFER class. The prior row therefore understates the class of evidence in existence by two steps and states a universal negative that is false.

BUT THE UPGRADE COMES WITH THREE LIMITS THAT KEEP THE CLAIM UNPROVEN, and I record them so the row is not read as vindication:
1. IDENTITY. Dadi's resident cells are explicitly NOT conventional NK. Verbatim: "these cells share a gene expression signature distinct from those of conventional NK cells, T cells and invariant NKT cells", and their generation is "dependent on the cytokine IL-15, but not the transcription factor Nfil3 that is required for the differentiation of tumor-infiltrating NK cells". Under the field's operational definition of trNK (CD49a+CD103+ NK1.1+/NCR1+ type-1 innate lymphocyte — the same definition Horowitz 2026 uses for "ctrNK" and the HCC CD49a+ NK literature uses), Dadi's ILC1l IS the claim's subject and the upgrade holds. Under a strict Eomes+ cNK definition of "NK", the very same figure is COUNTER-evidence: cNK showed HIGH non-host chimerism, i.e. conventional NK in tumour-bearing tissue are continuously exchanged with the circulation. X1's evidence class thus depends entirely on a nomenclature fork the claim text does not resolve, and this fork is the audit's central finding.
2. ENDPOINT. Parabiosis measures non-exchange of a phenotypically defined pool; it does not follow any individual pre-tumour cell into the tumour. "A becomes B" is still not observed. Non-exchange over a 2-week window is also a weak residency test by TRM-field standards (4-8+ weeks is standard), and there is no intravascular (i.v. anti-CD45) labelling control for vascular contamination.
3. n AND POOLING (G5). The parabiosis panel reports only "percentage of non-host chimerism was compiled from three independent experiments" with "each symbol denotes an individual mouse"; no explicit number of mice or parabiotic pairs is given in the text. EdU is "two independent experiments". Several panels use POOLED mammary glands and pooled tumours (Fig 5A: "sorted from pooled tumors of 20- to 24-week-old PyMT mice"; Fig 5D-E: "pooled mammary glands of 8-week-old wild-type (WT) and PyMT mice"), which destroys the animal as the unit of replication in those panels. n_unit = mice / parabiotic pairs, exact n not recoverable from the accessible text.

SEPARATELY, A PRECISION CORRECTION TO THE ANCHOR STUDY DESCRIPTION. The prior row's "CRITICAL NEGATIVE: no NK-specific tumour-versus-NILT clone-sharing test was performed" is overstated for Liu 2026 (PMID 42242233). Figure 2F is "Heatmap showing the fraction of all cell pairs belonging to the same clone and consisting of a lung tumor cell type and a NILT cell type", and NK/ILC is one of the annotated cell types in that atlas ("4 NK cell/ILC clusters (NCR1)"). The tumour-NK x NILT-NK entry is therefore PLOTTED; what is absent is any quantification of it in the text, any statistical test, and any interpretation — the accompanying text discusses only CD8 T, B/plasma and myeloid. Correct statement: the value exists in a figure and was never reported or interpreted. This does not change the classification (mtDNA clone sharing at one post-tumour timepoint cannot order events in time anyway), but the row asserted a stronger negative than the paper supports.

G2/G7 COMPLIANCE: no pseudotime or velocity result was credited; the Nat Commun 2026 CRC "biased toward ILC1/trNK differentiation" result remains INF_TRAJECTORY. The upgrade is not to make the claim interesting — the same source's cNK chimerism data and its Nfil3 genetics cut against the claim under the strict reading, and I have logged that as counter-evidence.
adv.revised_evidence_type_strongest: OBS_TRANSFER — congenic CD45.1/CD45.2 parabiosis chimerism in tumour-bearing MMTV-PyMT mice (Dadi et al., Cell 2016, PMID 26806130), paired with pre-transformation flow enumeration of the same population in wild-type mammary gland. Full set present, strongest first: OBS_TRANSFER (Dadi 2016 parabiosis); OBS_GENETIC (present in the adjacent lineage-identity literature and pointing AGAINST the NK reading — Nixon et al. Sci Immunol 2022 PMID 35394814 ILC-progenitor fate-mapping plus transfer, "did not interconvert with NK cells"; Flommersfeld et al. Immunity 2021 PMID 34437840 retrogenic single-cell colour barcoding); INF_KINETIC (EdU incorporation in CD49a-hi GzmB+ cells, Dadi Fig 5D-E); INF_MARKER (CD49a/CD103/CD69 overlap between intratumoural and organ trNK — the only class the prior row recognised); INF_INVITRO (TGF-beta-driven ctrNK differentiation from peripheral NK, Horowitz Sci Transl Med 2026 PMID 42090477); INF_TRAJECTORY (Nat Commun 2026 CRC immature-ILC differentiation bias). NOTE: under a strict Eomes+ conventional-NK reading of "trNK", the strongest class supporting X1 falls back to INF_MARKER exactly as the prior row said, because Dadi's parabiosis subject is explicitly not cNK — the class assignment is conditional on which definition of trNK the registry intends, and that must be resolved before the row is used.
adv.new_counter_evidence:
SIX items the prior audit missed, all verified by PMID lookup (eutils esummary run over all 16 cited PMIDs; every one resolves as cited).

(1) DADI 2016 ITSELF IS COUNTER-EVIDENCE UNDER THE STRICT NK READING (PMID 26806130). The same parabiosis that shows residency for ILC1l/ILTC1 shows the opposite for conventional NK: "the degree of non-host chimerism was much lower for ILC1ls... when compared to cNK". Conventional NK in tumour-bearing tissue are blood-exchanged. Reinforced genetically: Nfil3-/- mammary gland has cNK "greatly reduced" while "ILC1ls were unperturbed", and "Nfil3 deficiency did not affect tumor growth" whereas IL-15 deficiency accelerated it. Two populations, two origins, two dependencies, and the tumour-protective one is the non-NK one.

(2) NIXON ET AL., Sci Immunol 2022;7(70):eabi8642, PMID 35394814 (Li lab follow-up; lit.py methods -> ABSTRACT_ONLY, PMC9233921). Verbatim: "Cell fate-mapping and transfer studies revealed that granzyme C-expressing innate lymphocytes could be derived from ILC progenitors and did not interconvert with NK cells, ILC2s, or ILC3s." This is OBS_GENETIC-class evidence for TWO INDEPENDENT ORIGINS and against any NK-to-trNK/ILC1 interconversion; in the same paper "depleting ILC1s caused accelerated tumor growth" in a transgenic breast cancer model. If the intratumoural CD49a+CD103+ cells are ILC-progenitor-derived ILC1s, X1 is not merely untested, it is misattributed at the lineage level.

(3) FLOMMERSFELD ET AL., Immunity 2021;54(10):2288-2304.e7, PMID 34437840, PMC8528403 (OA full text read and archived as /home/user/aaa/refs/X1_PMC8528403.txt). Retrogenic colour barcoding of SINGLE Ly49H+CD27+ NK cells transferred into Rag2-/-Il2rg-/- recipients, MCMV infection: two distinct pre-existing NK lineages, one ILC1-like with splenic residency. Their Discussion states the canonical alternative for the tumour setting explicitly, verbatim: "in tumors, ILC1s have previously been described to arise via conversion from NK cells... The existence of ILC1-like NK cells in the spleen and lymph nodes of mice under steady-state conditions... raises the question whether converted ILC1s in tumors may originate selectively from this distinct NK cell lineage. Our findings underscore the importance of single-cell fate mapping for the study of differentiation processes such as conversion or selection emerging from a heterogenous population of NK cells." This is the prompt's canonical "a pre-existing subset is SELECTED/expanded rather than converted" alternative, demonstrated with true single-cell fate mapping and named for tumours by the authors themselves. Note this paper was already in the registry's refs under tag D2 (refs/D2_PMC8528403.txt) and the X1 auditor still did not use it.

(4) RESEARCH-INTEGRITY PROBLEM IN THE COUNTER-MODEL THE PRIOR ROW LEANED ON. Gao et al., Nat Immunol 2017;18(9):1004-1015, PMID 28759001 ("Tumor immunoevasion by the conversion of effector NK cells into type 1 innate lymphoid cells") — the single most-cited transfer-based support for "recruited NK convert into intratumoural trNK/ILC1-like cells" — carries a 2024 Author Correction, PMID 38514890, doi 10.1038/s41590-024-01799-9. Verbatim from the correction notice: figures "5e and 6d,e and Supplementary Figs. 5c,d and 8c" were removed because they "were based on experiments for which no evidence of their conduct or primary data could be confirmed. As such, the data from the underlying experiments are believed to have been fabricated or are unreliable." The authors assert "The major finding of the paper that TGF-beta-driven conversion of NK cells into ILC1s is a novel mechanism by which tumors escape surveillance by the innate immune system remains unaffected" and "No concerns have been raised regarding other data in the paper." I could not determine from the notice alone whether the removed panels are the transfer/conversion panels themselves. Consequence for this row: the prior audit's "strongest alternative explanation" (de novo conversion of recruited cNK) is itself resting partly on a paper with fabricated-or-unreliable panels, while the competing no-interconversion result (item 2) comes from an intact fate-mapping study. This does not rescue X1 — it degrades both sides — but a preregistered screen must record it.

(5) DUCIMETIERE PNAS 2021 (PMID 34183415) — the prior row cited it as full text at refs/X1_PMC8271692.txt; that file is 13.8 KB and contains only the PubMed record plus reference list, not the full text. The finding cited (trILC1 controls seeding, cNK restrains outgrowth) is from the abstract. Flagging under G1: the row's use of it is abstract-level, not methods-level.

(6) The Nat Immunol 2024 pan-cancer NK atlas quote the prior row relies on (PMID 38956379) verifies, and its hedge stands, but it is a compositional argument and cannot discriminate origins in either direction.
adv.crossfield_g4_findings:
The mechanism's home field is recruitment-versus-residency of a pre-existing tissue population inside a tumour. Two fields have the tools; both have run the experiment; neither returns the clean answer X1 asserts.

MYELOID (the field where this exact structural claim is settled). Loyher PL et al., "Macrophages of distinct origins contribute to tumor development in the lung," J Exp Med 2018;215(10):2536-2553, PMID 30201786, PMC6170177 — OA full text retrieved and read (refs/X1_PMC6170177.txt). Methods, not abstract: transgenic fluorescent reporter mice (MacBlue x Cx3cr1-EGFP/+), fate-mapping models, Ccr2-/-, and parabiosis, in mouse lung tumours. Verbatim result: "In pulmonary nodules of WT mice, the ratio of ECFP+/EGFP+ cells was 0.57 +/- 0.10, whereas the corresponding ratio was 0.14 +/- 0.08 in Ccr2-/- mice and 0.96 +/- 0.07 in host parabiont mice", and "the TAM compartment is intermingled by both yolk sac-derived interstitial and monocyte-derived recruited macrophages, differentially represented in the TME depending on the anatomical site of tumor development in the lung." Casanova-Acebes M et al., Nature 2021;595:578-584, PMID 34135508 (lit.py methods -> ABSTRACT_ONLY, PMC8923521 not released; I did NOT obtain its Methods and do not quote them): lineage tracing places tissue-resident macrophages next to tumour cells early, with the TME later "dominated by monocyte-derived macrophages". Also Zhu Y et al., Immunity 2017, PMID 28813661/28930665 (PDAC, embryonic-origin resident macrophages). HOME-FIELD VERDICT: (i) the claim type is testable and has been tested wherever fate maps exist; the absence of the NK experiment is neglect, not impossibility — which sharpens rather than excuses X1's status; (ii) where tested, the answer is never "resident becomes intratumoural" but "both origins contribute, resident-derived dominate early and are progressively displaced by recruited cells, and the split depends on anatomical site". An unqualified X1 has no precedent in the one lineage where the question is answerable.

T CELL / TRM (the field with a true clonal barcode). Pre-existing resident memory can protect against a later tumour: Malik BT et al., Sci Immunol 2017, PMID 28738020 (skin TRM present before melanoma challenge mediate durable immunity); Enamorado M et al., Nat Commun 2017, PMID 28714465 (resident AND circulating memory both required — the interplay, not residency alone); Molodtsov A et al., Immunity 2021, PMID 34525340 (LN TRM against metastatic melanoma). Against local origin of the functional intratumoural effector pool: Yost KE et al., "Clonal replacement of tumor-specific T cells following PD-1 blockade," Nat Med 2019, PMID 31359002 — in the only lineage with a somatic clonal barcode, the clones that expand in the tumour after checkpoint blockade are largely NOT the pre-existing intratumoural clones but novel clones entering from outside. Structural read-across: the population that does the work inside a tumour is substantially replenished from outside even when a bona fide resident pool exists. Combined with Liu 2026's own NSCLC observation (the only NK cross-site clonal result runs blood -> tissue, 66.0% PBMC / 25.3% tumour / 8.8% NILT in donor SU-L-005), the T-cell field's answer predicts recruitment contributes materially, which X1 as phrased excludes. NOT FOUND despite four attempts: the human lung-transplant TRM chimerism study (Snyder/Farber) and Wu TD et al. Nature 2020 did not surface through lit.py under four different query formulations — recorded as searched-and-not-retrieved, NOT as non-existent (G3).

ILC. Nixon 2022 (PMID 35394814) fate map: GzmC+ ILC1s come from ILC progenitors and do not interconvert with NK. Friedrich C et al., Nat Immunol 2021, PMID 34462601: Hobit drives ILC1 effector differentiation downstream of lineage commitment across tissues — i.e. the residency programme is installed within a committed ILC1 lineage, not by conversion of NK. Ducimetiere 2021 (PMID 34183415): trILC1 and cNK non-redundant in liver metastasis. Convergent home-field position: the resident type-1 innate compartment in tissues is a separate committed lineage from cNK, which makes "organ trNK -> intratumoural NK" a claim about a population whose lineage boundary with NK is itself contested.

EXHAUSTION: NOT_SEARCHED — the CD8 exhaustion-consensus literature bears on rows X2/X4, not on X1's recruitment-versus-residency structure, so I did not spend searches there.

adv.load_bearing_reason:
The prior row graded HIGH but its own headline dependency defeats the grade, and it said so without following through. Horowitz NB et al., Sci Transl Med 2026;18(848):eadw5567, PMID 42090477 (abstract verified; refs/X1_42090477.txt) builds its entire ACT platform by differentiating and expanding CD39+CD49a+CD103+ ctrNK EX VIVO FROM PERIPHERAL NK — verbatim from the record: "our observations that ctrNK cells can be differentiated and expanded ex vivo present a potential platform for adoptive cell therapy of solid tumour malignancies." That programme is origin-agnostic by construction: it is unaffected whether intratumoural trNK were resident before the tumour, recruited and converted, or manufactured in a flask. A dependency that survives the claim being false is not evidence of HIGH load-bearing.

CONCRETE NAMED DEPENDENCIES THAT DO SURVIVE SCRUTINY, all interpretive rather than interventional:
1. Nixon BG et al., Sci Immunol 2022, PMID 35394814 — competing-interests statement, verbatim from the PubMed record: "MSKCC has filed a patent application with the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office directed toward targeting ILC1 IL-15 signaling for cancer immunotherapy." A filed patent and a therapeutic axis (IL-15 support of a resident cytotoxic type-1 innate compartment) premised on a tumour-surveilling population that is locally maintained rather than recruited. Note the axis is chosen BECAUSE of the residency model: in Dadi 2016, IL-15 deficiency accelerated tumour growth while Nfil3 deficiency (which ablates tumour-infiltrating NK) did not — so the therapeutic lever picked is the resident-supporting one, not a recruitment-targeting one. If X1 is false and the effective cells are recruited, the lever is mis-chosen. That is a real, named, falsifiable dependency.
2. Sun C et al., "Accumulation of Tumor-Infiltrating CD49a+ NK Cells Correlates with Poor Prognosis for Human Hepatocellular Carcinoma," Cancer Immunol Res 2019, PMID 31311791 (verified). Its causal reading — a pre-existing liver-resident compartment turning bad — inverts entirely if those cells were recruited and converted in situ, in which case the prognostic signal is a TME-exposure readout, not a residency pedigree.
3. Registry-internal: rows T1 (cNK -> trNK) and T4 (NK -> ILC1 in tumours) are mutually constraining with X1, as the prior row correctly noted; X1 cannot be graded independently of them.
4. The review-level framework built on Dadi/Nixon — Annu Rev Immunol 2024, "Multilayered Immunity by Tissue-Resident Lymphocytes in Cancer," PMID 38424658 (verified) — is the largest structure resting on the claim, but it is a framing, and it rests on real parabiosis data rather than on X1 as an assumption.

MEDIUM, not HIGH: no therapy, trial, biomarker or manufacturing decision fails if X1 is false — the one candidate (ctrNK ACT) is explicitly independent of it, and the ILC1/IL-15 axis is supported by depletion and knockout phenotypes that stand on their own. What changes is the interpretation of a marker literature and the choice between preserve-the-resident-pool and promote-recruitment strategies. Not LOW, because that interpretive layer is large and because the prognostic literature reads causality off it.
adv.better_primary_source:
Dadi S, Chhangawala S, Whitlock BM, Franklin RA, Luo CT, Oh SA, Toure A, Pritykin Y, Huse M, Leslie CS, Li MO. "Cancer Immunosurveillance by Tissue-Resident Innate Lymphoid Cells and Innate-like T Cells." Cell 2016 Jan 28;164(3):365-377. PMID 26806130; PMC4733424; doi 10.1016/j.cell.2016.01.002. fulltext_available = PARTIAL: lit.py methods returns ABSTRACT_ONLY (NIHMS author manuscript, not in the OA subset) and Europe PMC fullTextXML returns 0 bytes; the complete text WAS read via the PMC HTML rendering (curl + WebFetch of https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4733424/) and every quote in this row is verbatim from Results/Figure legends, never from the abstract.

WHY IT DISPLACES LIU 2026 (PMID 42242233) AS THE ANCHOR. Liu 2026 has the right architecture for humans but never ran an NK-specific test and cannot order events in time from a single post-resection timepoint; it is anchored on the absence of an analysis. Dadi 2016 actually performs, in one animal model, the three measurements X1 requires: (a) the resident population is enumerated in the organ BEFORE transformation — "GzmB-expressing cells from all three lineages were present in WT mice at low numbers... Cell transformation expanded all populations"; (b) congenic CD45.1/CD45.2 parabiosis in the tumour-bearing animal (joined at 6 weeks, analysed 2 weeks later) shows the CD49a-hi CD103+ NK1.1+ population is not blood-replenished while cNK are — Figure 5 is titled "Tissue-resident ILC1ls and ILTC1s expand in precancerous lesions"; (c) EdU shows the expansion is local proliferation of the pre-existing pool, not immigration, with function established by Prf1-/- and Il15-/- tumour-growth phenotypes.

WHAT IT STILL DOES NOT DO, so the claim remains untested as literally worded: no individual pre-tumour cell is labelled and followed into an established tumour (no photoconversion, no inducible Cre fate map, no exogenous barcode), so "A becomes B" is inferred from non-exchange plus local proliferation, not observed; the parabiosis window is only 2 weeks and lacks an i.v.-labelling vascular control; the lesions are PRECANCEROUS/early, not established tumours; per-panel animal n is unreported and several panels pool glands or tumours across mice; the model is autochthonous mouse mammary/prostate, with no human counterpart; and, decisively, the paper defines its resident cells as transcriptionally "distinct from those of conventional NK cells" and Nfil3-independent, so calling them "trNK" is the field's convention, not this paper's claim. The honest one-line status is therefore: X1 is UNTESTED AS WORDED but NOT UNADDRESSED — a congenic parabiosis in a tumour-bearing animal with a pre-tumour baseline exists, it points the way X1 points, and it is about a population its own authors say is not NK.

CHEAPEST DECISIVE EXPERIMENT (revised from the prior row): not a re-analysis of GSE302113 (underpowered — NK are depleted in tumour vs NILT and clone assignment is 15-26% in tissue at n=5), but the mouse experiment Dadi stopped one step short of: Ncr1- or Hobit-driven inducible fate mapping, or Kaede photoconversion of the uninvolved organ, performed BEFORE tumour induction in an autochthonous model, reading out labelled-cell frequency in the established tumour — with Nfil3-/- or ILC-progenitor fate mapping run in parallel to settle whether the labelled cells are NK or ILC1.

final.resolution_note: The reviewer found a real experiment the audit had wrongly declared non-existent (Dadi et al., Cell 2016, PMID 26806130: CD45.1/CD45.2 congenic parabiosis in tumour-bearing MMTV-PyMT mice with pre-transformation enumeration of the same population), and correctly made the class CONDITIONAL on which entity 'trNK' denotes. Under an operational trNK definition (CD49a+CD103+ NK1.1+) Dadi's ILC1-like cells are the claim's subject and the class upgrades to OBS_TRANSFER; under a strict Eomes+ conventional-NK definition the same figure is COUNTER-evidence, because cNK showed HIGH non-host chimerism, i.e. conventional NK in tumour-bearing tissue are continuously exchanged with the circulation. RESOLUTION: this registry's own ontology treats ILC1 as distinct from NK - claim T4 is 'NK -> ILC1' and claim P3 turns on whether liver memory cells are NK or ILC1. Both presuppose the distinction, so 'trNK' in X1 must mean NK-lineage tissue-resident NK, not ILC1-like cells. Dadi's population is explicitly not conventional NK (Nfil3-independent, 'gene expression signature distinct from conventional NK cells'), so under DEC-05 it addresses a neighbouring but different transition. X1 keeps INF_MARKER, and Dadi's cNK chimerism data is recorded as counter-evidence.
